query:
SELECT 
  JSON_KEYS(JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0]')) as comp_keys,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].rating') as rating,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].occupancy') as occupancy,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].adr') as adr,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].bedrooms') as bedrooms,
  JSON_EXTRACT(reportData, '$.comparables[0].bathrooms') as bathrooms
FROM universal_shareable_reports
WHERE shareCode = '2v9cjmVa9k';
